name: strata-knobs
description: One-knob-at-a-time Strata engine sweep at 1k/4k/16k, concurrency 1 and 4, on one L40S.
caveats: Variants are one knob each; nospec and expert_cache_max are recorded as launch-fail/skipped-flag because engine 0.1.50 refuses them.
Every variant passes --mtp on explicitly (except mtpoff) because strata launch persists that choice in the shared installed config.
The vramreserve variant in attic/ is invalid: it inherited --mtp off from the previous variant. Use the redo, not the attic.
Only small contexts: 64k/131k, V100 and multi-GPU are separate recipes by design.
A variant's private data dir is seeded from the shared _strata-data tree; concurrent launches of the same pack can rewrite install/strata-<pack>.json.
